verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated ISO 27001 product with certification support (vanta-docs-50), AI-powered ISMS templates for roles, responsibilities, and risks (vanta-docs-18, vanta-docs-39), and ISO 27001 listed as a headline framework (vanta-docs-63). Generic audit workflows (auditor collaboration, an Auditor API, information requests) suggest certification-audit support, and the API can filter evidence by framework (vanta-docs-1). Missing for 10: any evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation or management, ISO-specific certification-audit artifacts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
